about.title: About JAM Smart Tech
about.subtitle: Premium device repair and electronics retail, built around trust, speed, and genuine parts.
about.storyBody: JAM Smart Tech started as a neighborhood repair counter and grew into a full-service destination for device repair and accessories. Every repair is backed by a warranty, every part is genuine or manufacturer-grade, and every customer gets real-time tracking from booking to delivery.

contact.title: Get In Touch
contact.toastSuccess: Message sent! We'll get back to you soon.

duration.q: How long does a typical repair take?
duration.a: Most screen and battery repairs are completed same-day, often within 45-90 minutes for in-store visits.

warranty.q: Do you offer a warranty on repairs?
warranty.a: Yes, every repair includes a warranty ranging from 90 days to 12 months depending on the service.

methods.a: Store visit, pickup & delivery, mail-in repair, and on-site repair — availability depends on your location and device.

track.q: Can I track my repair or order?
track.a: Yes, use the Track Repair or Track Order links in the navbar with your booking or order number.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: We accept all major cards and popular local payment methods through our secure Stripe-powered checkout.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
items: We collect only the information necessary to process your repair bookings and orders — including contact details, device information, and shipping addresses.
Payment processing is handled securely by Stripe. We never store your full card number or CVV on our servers.
Your data is never sold to third parties. We use it solely to fulfill orders, manage repair bookings, and improve our services.
You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting our support team.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
items: By booking a repair or placing an order with JAM Smart Tech, you agree to the pricing, warranty terms, and service timelines presented at the time of booking or checkout.
Repair pricing is determined by device category, brand, model, configuration, and the selected repair service, and is confirmed before any payment is required.
Orders are subject to product availability. We reserve the right to cancel or refund orders that cannot be fulfilled.
Warranty coverage varies by repair type and is stated on the relevant service page and booking confirmation.
